page.overview:
Who is Angel?

Angel is a downloadable Ghost Duelist in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008.

Angel was created by Emily Fuchs, the runner-up in the 2008 DS World Championship. Her and the other top three players characters were made available as downloadable Ghosts in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008.
